revision_note: Cut 1 makes the wardrobe woman's slide-out setup more natural; Cut 2 removes clipping and keeps the body fully separated from wardrobe and clothes.
global_style: bright warm home lighting, mixed natural and overhead light, UGC mobile photography style, visible living traces, slight messy aesthetic

shots.description: Medium shot, fixed camera, Malay hijab woman holding one baby with her left arm, right hand pulling the black metal handle of a white wardrobe. The wardrobe door has just opened enough for packed dark clothes to push outward. Behind the clothes, the brown-haired woman in beige T-shirt, black jeans, and white shoes is naturally beginning to slide diagonally out from the wardrobe threshold: part of her head or shoulder, one arm, and one lower leg or white shoe are visible in the gap. She is still partly inside the wardrobe, not suddenly standing outside, and no full reveal yet.

Medium shot, fixed camera, white wardrobe opens wider and massive dark clothes spill outward; the same brown-haired woman slides fully out from the wardrobe threshold in one continuous motion, body angled forward/downward as if pushed by the clothing pile. Her complete head, torso, arms, legs, and white shoes are visible, anatomically plausible, and clearly separated from the wardrobe panels and falling clothes. Clothes move behind and around her without passing through her body. Malay hijab mother holding baby leans backward in surprise while keeping baby safe.

Full shot, slight camera shake, same brown-haired woman finishes tumbling forward from the wardrobe threshold and falls backward onto the clothes pile, legs raised, physically plausible comic fall with no body intersection through wardrobe doors or clothing pile.
shots.voiceover: Subject falling onto the clothing pile.

shots.description: Medium close-up, downward tilt, same brown-haired woman sitting up among clothes, palms facing outward.
Medium close-up, slight zoom in, hands opening gray-white striped soft fabric storage bag with dark gray zipper and handles, placing it on lap or floor.
Close-up, fixed overhead shot, hands moving downward, grabbing folded clothes, stacking neatly inside gray-white striped soft storage bag.
shots.voiceover: Stacking folded clothes inside the bag.

shots.description: Extreme close-up, fixed camera, hands pinching double zipper sliders, sliding horizontally to close gray-white striped soft storage bag, grabbing gray side handles, lifting upward.
shots.voiceover: Closing the bag and lifting the handles.
